data.publisher: Colorado Department of State (Colorado Information Marketplace)
data.subject: a newly formed business entity (legal business name, entity type, principal business address, formation date)
data.countNote: Domestic LLCs and corporations with a Colorado principal address formed: Jul 14,119, Aug 13,305, Sep 12,282, Oct 1 to 22 9,404. Update schedule every day after midnight; rows updated 2026-10-22. Registered agent person name fields are dropped.

license.note: The dataset carries a Public Domain license (metadata license id PUBLIC_DOMAIN). The portal terms disclaim all warranties, say use is at your own risk, require apps using the data to carry the State's disclaimer that the data was modified from its State of Colorado source, and let the State require that display or distribution stop. No indemnity clause.

overlap: launches/chicago-new-business-licenses.md (new business signal, different buyers). Crowded: FreshFilings and several Apify actors already sell this exact Colorado feed. Many one person LLCs list a home as the principal address; the Legal desk decides whether to drop addresses that are not a commercial premises.
dropReason: Dropped Oct 23 after demand and red team FAIL with no honest fix: the State says the same data is free on its portal, FreshFilings sends it daily for $49 with a trial, many addresses are registered-agent offices or homes, and the only accountant thread found had 0 of 11 willing to pay. Data and legal PASS.
